purpose: Additive P3 remediation package for the P4 FAIL against v2.2. It closes the caller-fabricated Human/live-Git trust-boundary blocker without rewriting frozen architecture, prior P3 evidence, or repository history.

architecture_amendment.decision: AD-V2.1-001 — FRESH EXACT PUBLIC-EFFECT AUTHORITY GATE

p4_input_verdict.blocker: The effect-capable consumer could reach sink.write after only structural validation of caller-supplied Human authority and caller-supplied/replayed Git/revalidation evidence.
p4_input_verdict.required_remediation: Before sink.write, genuine durable Human decision and fresh/live Git base, ancestry, candidate, diff/topology and write-time state must be obtained/verified through trusted evidence sources/adapters rather than caller assertions.

implementation_files.role: Deterministic, non-effect-capable manifest/authority tuple builder. Caller-declared evidence is explicitly CALLER_DECLARED_NOT_EFFECT_CAPABLE; legacy execute_authorized_public_effect is physically disarmed and always returns BLOCKED + UNKNOWN without invoking the sink.

Sole canonical effect-capable runtime. It owns concrete live Git evidence retrieval/proof, concrete immutable GitHub Issue Comment Human-authority verification, a second distinct live Git write-time observation, and only then the write sink call.
Pure-builder and adversarial tests, including direct reproduction of the P4 caller-fabricated authority/revalidation counterexample with zero FakeSink calls.

Non-public harness using a real temporary bare Git repository to prove ancestry/object/mode/topology reads, plus immutable-Human-comment, stale-authority, write-time race, app-mediated-authority and test-source isolation cases.

trusted_runtime_boundary.fresh_base_observation: git ls-remote per trusted invocation followed by exact fetch/FETCH_HEAD identity check
trusted_runtime_boundary.candidate_topology: git rev-list --reverse --topo-order plus git show exact commit/tree/ordered parents
trusted_runtime_boundary.human_authority_source: GitHubIssueCommentAuthoritySource GET of exact GitHub Issue Comment
human_authority_verifies: exact Human actor login/id and User type
durable comment node/body hash evidence reference
trusted_runtime_boundary.write_time_revalidation: a second distinct trusted Git source invocation must recompute the exact same Human-bound authority_request before the sole write call
trusted_runtime_boundary.test_source_isolation: test-only trusted sources are accepted only with exact InMemoryNonPublicTestSink; any external-like sink is BLOCKED before write

p4_counterexample_remediation.old_path: prepare_public_effect_gate(caller data) -> caller-created authority -> caller-created revalidation -> execute_authorized_public_effect -> sink.write
p4_counterexample_remediation.current_result: execute_authorized_public_effect always returns BLOCKED with reason UNTRUSTED_CALLER_EVIDENCE_NOT_EFFECT_CAPABLE and zero sink calls
p4_counterexample_remediation.canonical_effect_path: trusted Git observation -> exact authority request -> immutable GitHub Human comment verification -> second distinct trusted Git observation -> exact tuple equality -> sink.write
